rag.text:
Test: TC-2936 — Global - Tempo Integration - Integration with Tempo on JC
Priority: High | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-397 Global - Tempo Integration
Labels: be-enterprise, ppm-e2e-cloud

Description:
Install Timesheets by Tempo - Jira Time Tracking and Tempo Core | Project Tracking for Jira

Steps:
1. Navigate to App Configuration->Intergations->Tempo
   Expected: Credentials tab is displayed.

There are displayed:

* Dropdown "How to get credentials?"
* Empty form "Client ID"
* Empty form "Client secret"
* Save button
2. Click dropdown "How to get credentials?"
   Expected: Help "How to get credentials?" is displayed:

Go to Tempo Cloud settings and add a new application. Enter the folLowing information:
Name of your application: BigPicture
Redirect URL: *Redirect URL is your instance cloudmanager URL + rest/oauth2/authorization/accept-code*
Client type: Confidential
Authorization grant type: Authorization code
After confirmation, you will get the credentials that have to be provided on this screen.
3. Click on the icon next to Redirect URL to copy it.
   Expected: The URL is copied to clipboard.
4. Navigate to Tempo->Settings->OAuth 2.0 Applications in a new tab of your browser
   Expected: OAuth 2.0 Applications screen is displayed with button "+ New Application"
5. Click the button "+ New Application"
   Expected: Modal window "Create Application" is displayed.
6. Fill the forms with Test Data and click Create Application
   Data: Name: BigPicture
Redirect URIs: Paste URL copied to clipboard
Client type: Confidential
Authorization grant type: Authorization code
   Expected: New modal window is displayed with Credentials
7. Copy Client ID and then move back to first tab and paste Client ID to into Client ID form
   Expected: "Client ID" form is filled. The credentials are not displayed, hidden with "*"
8. Copy Client secret from the other tab into form "Client secret"
   Expected: "Client secret" form is filled. The credentials are not displayed, hidden with "*"
9. Click Save
   Expected: Changes are successfully saved
10. Navigate to Administration->Resources
   Expected: Individuals tab is displayed.
11. Click Synchronize with Tempo in the right top corner
   Expected: Popup appears:

"This process may take a while if there is a significant number of users to sync."

There are two buttons:
"Proceed" and "Cancel"
12. Click "Proceed"
   Expected: New tab is opened with text:

*BigPicture would like to:*
Access your Tempo Data

Two buttons are displayed:
"Authorize Access" and "Deny Access"
13. Click "Authorize Access"
   Expected: Message is displayed:

Success!
Click ''Onwards!'' to connect BP with Tempo
14. Click "Onwards!"
   Expected: The second tab is closed and first tab with Indiviuals tab is displayed again.

Modal window is displayed:
"Authorization in progress...
Tempo requires authorization. Make sure that your browser alLows pop-ups. Once the authorization process is completed, you will be able to proceed with Tempo synchronization."

Button "Synchronize with Tempo" is grayed out.
15. Wait for authorization process to be completed.
   Expected: Modal window is displayed:
"Authorization completed

Tempo can be synchronized now."

Button "Synchronize with Tempo" is active.
16. Click "Synchronize with Tempo"
   Expected: "Authorization completed" windows is closed.

New modal window in the top right corner is displayed:
"Sync in progress
The items are currently being synchronized. We will inform you when the process is completed"
17. Wait for synchronization process to be completed.
   Expected: New modal window in the top right corner is displayed:
"Synchronization finished
Synchronization with Tempo was successfully finished."

On the list of resources users from Tempo are displayed with SYNCED label in Tempo Sync Status column.
